title: Why Ford Built a Mustang to Beat Porsche
description:
Why did Ford build a Mustang to beat Porsche? Here is the honest answer, and it starts with a correction. None of the sources we read says Ford built the Mustang GTD to beat Porsche. What they do say is stranger and more specific: a Le Mans race car, a chief executive who liked it, a seven-minute lap of the Nürburgring, and a Canadian company called Multimatic. This is the story, with every claim sourced. We read Torque Café, Design News, Motor One, The Drive, AutoGuide and Wikipedia. We will tell you what Ford's executives said in their own words, what the lap times were, and where the sources disagree. We will also tell you what nobody has said. And we will show you why Porsche belongs in the story, even though no source puts it there as the target.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
